heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of the corporation are—

tree.text: to form a bond of friendship and comradeship among all holders of the Medal of Honor as presented by Congress;
to protect, uphold, and preserve the dignity and honor of the medal at all times and on all occasions;
to protect the name of the medal and individual holders of the medal from exploitation;
to provide appropriate aid to all persons to whom the medal has been awarded, their widows, or their children;
to serve our country in peace as in war;
to inspire and stimulate our youth to become worthy citizens of our country; and
